title: Degreewise monicity of the restricted sections inclusion
statement: For any scheme X, bounded-below complex K, presentation T, integers q,n, the degree-n component of the restricted sections inclusion is monic.

proof.text: Use the existing degreewise stupid-truncation retraction, map it through sections and extension, and assemble its diagonal coproduct by totalDesc. Checking on coprojections proves the retraction identity. The sections inclusion is precomposition by the explicit comparison isomorphism.

proof_origin.by: independent second reader B3; explicit totalDesc retraction proof
proof_origin.place: Tag 015J, proof remark (3), finite diagonal comparison
